intro.headline: From buyer PO to supplier-ready order

outro.headline: Send every purchase order in the format each supplier needs.

beats.vo: ProcuLink turns purchase orders from the formats buyers use into the exact orders each supplier expects.
beats.shot: Short brand opener followed by the current upload workbench.

beats.vo: Start with the file you already have. Upload a spreadsheet, CSV, PDF, XML, cXML, or EDI order. Email, API, and managed file intake can feed the same workflow.
beats.shot: Upload a fictional CSV and show the real intake affordances.

beats.vo: ProcuLink detects the format, reads the order, keeps the source visible, and routes it to the selected supplier flow.
beats.shot: Detected format, PO number, line count, and selected supplier are visible.

beats.vo: The order opens in review. Source, normalized data, and supplier output stay connected, while the work queue focuses attention on the exceptions that can block delivery.
beats.shot: Current approved three-column order workshop; do not redesign it.

beats.vo: For an unresolved item, ProcuLink suggests the supplier code with confidence and evidence. Accept it when it is right.
beats.shot: Accept one real mock AI suggestion and show the issue count decrease.

beats.vo: When you know better, enter the value yourself. Saving the mapping makes the same buyer-to-supplier match reusable on the next order.
beats.shot: Enter a supplier item code, save, and show the line resolved.

beats.vo: Before sending, supplier rules check required fields, totals, item mappings, and output readiness. Blocking issues stay visible until they are fixed.
beats.shot: Readiness and validation area with a truthful ready state.

beats.vo: Preview exactly what the supplier will receive. The configured template controls the structure, field mappings, format, and delivery channel.
beats.shot: Switch to full document or supplier output preview with readable output.

beats.vo: Send when the order is ready. ProcuLink generates the artifact, transmits it on the configured channel, and reports delivery success or a recoverable failure.
beats.shot: Confirm send and show generating, sending, then delivered transmission state.

beats.vo: The audit trail records what changed, who changed it, what was generated, where it was sent, and the result. Your source remains intact throughout.
beats.shot: Current delivery log and order audit proof, without implying business acceptance.

beats.vo: Review the exceptions. Control the output. Send every supplier the order they require. ProcuLink.
